policies.uncertain_soft: 15% UNKNOWN; 30% soften definite answer, deterministic 12 seeds per entry
policies.mixed_noise: 15% UNKNOWN; 5% reverse known answer; 25% soften definite answer, 12 seeds per entry
policies.single_flip_each_early_position: 10 separate games reverse one known answer at a chosen early position; UNKNOWN cannot be reversed

scope: Matrix perturbation tests check engine robustness only. Independent fixtures are separate. Ten rejected guesses is a test cap, not a UI cap. No human user study was run.

independent_sparse_answers.interpretation: Only independently sourced answers are supplied. Everything else is UNKNOWN; failure can mean insufficient coverage, not a false fact.
